estate_courtyard.label: Inner courtyard of Padmini Amma's estate
estate_courtyard.anchor: The inner courtyard of Padmini Amma's tharavadu in Travancore: red-tiled sloping roofs on laterite walls and timber pillars, coconut palms beyond, a great jackfruit tree shading a worn stone platform, kitchen steps at one side and the courtyard entrance opposite. Beyond a low wall lies the sunken red-earth kalari pit where boys spar.
estate_courtyard.absent: No chairs, benches, stools or European furniture, no glass lanterns, no foreign fort and no Deccan scenery outside a specified memory stain. Whenever Nagoji appears here he is bare-headed, never in a turban, coat or red sash.
estate_courtyard.time: monsoon-season midday, deep shade under the jackfruit tree and heavy cloud building in the north

deccan_village.label: Village fields near Nashik in the letter
deccan_village.anchor: The land near Nashik in the Deccan as the letter pictures it: black-soil fields cracked and waiting for rain, a low stone village of flat-roofed houses, dry flat-topped hills beyond and a pale sky.
deccan_village.absent: No coconut palms, paddy, sea, tiled Kerala roofs or present-day Travancore figures, and no Nagoji in the fields.
deccan_village.time: dawn under a pale, dry sky

deccan_fort_road.label: Deccan hill fort and road in the letter
deccan_fort_road.anchor: A Deccan hill fort of dark basalt walls and bastions along the rim of a flat-topped scarp, with a dusty road crossing dry scrub below it. Two small bands of Maratha riders in white or cream angarkhas and pagdis pass each other on the road, each under its own pennant.
deccan_fort_road.absent: No emblems, crescents or lettering on either pennant, no rust-red turban with a red sash, no coast, palms or European troops.

pune_darbar.label: Darbar hall in Pune in the letter
pune_darbar.anchor: A Maratha darbar hall in Pune as the letter pictures it: carved teak pillars and cusped arches, white cotton floor spreads with bolsters, and sardars in pagdis and angarkhas seated on the floor around a hand-painted cloth map in the Indian style, rivers as blue bands and forts as small pictograms.
pune_darbar.absent: No European map, globe, chairs or table, no outline of the subcontinent's coastline, no lettering on the map, no Travancore figures and no named portrait.

storm_memory.label: The storm at sea in memory
storm_memory.anchor: The remembered storm at sea: the high black hull of the prisoner ship heeled hard over in black boiling water, its deck awash and its mainmast snapped, rain driving in sheets under lightning.
storm_memory.absent: No coast, palms or present-day Travancore figures, no red or blue coats, no rescue boat and no blood.

king_study.label: Small lamp-lit room off the war hall
king_study.anchor: A small room off the Travancore war hall: laterite walls under a dark timber ceiling, shelves of palm-leaf bundles, rolled maps and a few cloth-wrapped European volumes, a low platform at the left and a woven mat on the floor before it at the right. Whenever both men are in view, Varma sits on the platform at the left and Nagoji on the mat at the right, and a dark corridor of timber pillars runs past the open doorway.
king_study.absent: No throne, European chairs, desk, table, candles or glass lamp, and no guards or attendants unless the panel names them.
king_study.time: night, lit by a single brass oil lamp with an open wick

fort_yard.label: Travancore fort yard and gate
fort_yard.anchor: The yard inside a red laterite Travancore fort with sloping tiled gatehouse roofs: men load bullock carts with grain sacks, water pots and bundled supplies, and the carts roll out through the open fort gate toward the northern road.
fort_yard.absent: No foreign bastions, European wagons or harnessed horses, no blue or red coats and no Maratha pennants.

velinadu_verandah.label: Verandah of the Velinadu house
velinadu_verandah.anchor: The verandah of the Velinadu house, Revathi's family hall: a raised laterite plinth under deep tiled eaves, dark carved wooden pillars, a polished floor and open clay or brass oil lamps just lit along the edge.
velinadu_verandah.absent: No chairs or benches, no glass lanterns, no foreign buildings and no jackfruit courtyard from Padmini's estate.

quarters_verandah.label: Verandah of Nagoji's quarters at night
quarters_verandah.anchor: The verandah of Nagoji's quarters on Padmini's estate: a low laterite plinth under tiled eaves on timber posts, a small wall niche beside the door holding a brass oil lamp, and beyond the edge coconut palms with irrigation channels glinting between them.
quarters_verandah.absent: No writing board, chairs or benches on the verandah, no glass lantern, and no other figures or Deccan scenery outside a specified memory stain.

sea_wreck.label: Wreck beneath the night sea
sea_wreck.anchor: The night sea off this coast, seen at the waterline and below it: a thin line of moonlit surface at the top, and beneath it in black water the broken timbers of a wrecked ship, a split spar and loose planks settling on the sand.
sea_wreck.absent: No bones, body, figure, chains, fish shoals or treasure, and no ship afloat on the surface.
sea_wreck.time: night, faint moonlight filtering down through black water

harbour_market.label: Harbour market and the sowcar's stall
harbour_market.anchor: A Travancore market near the harbour: fish baskets, pepper sacks and oil jars under cloth and palm-leaf awnings, tiled roofs with the masts of local coastal craft beyond them. Under a cloth awning stands the Gujarati sowcar's stall, a low platform spread with white cloth with a balance scale, a cloth-bound ledger, a small brass inkpot and a reed pen; anyone seated on it sits cross-legged.
harbour_market.absent: No European ships at a quay, no chairs, tables or counters, no blue or red coats, no glass lanterns and no legible marks on coins, ledger or paper.

writing_room.label: Inside Nagoji's quarters, the night before
writing_room.anchor: Inside Nagoji's quarters on Padmini's estate: a low wooden writing board on a woven mat, a sheet of paper, a reed pen, a small brass inkpot and a small brass oil lamp with an open wick beside the board, laterite walls falling into shadow.
writing_room.absent: No desk, chair, table, quill, candle or glass lamp, and no readable writing anywhere.
writing_room.time: late night, the brass lamp burning high and warm

estate_gate.label: Gate of Padmini Amma's estate
estate_gate.anchor: The gate of Padmini Amma's estate: a tiled timber gatehouse set in a laterite wall, a red-earth path outside it, and through it the red-tiled tharavadu with its verandah and the jackfruit tree in the inner courtyard.
estate_gate.absent: No iron gates, European lamp posts or glass lanterns, no foreign fort, and no Deccan scenery outside the specified split background.
estate_gate.time: late afternoon turning to dusk, low gold light, long shadows and the first lamp glowing in the house

character_notes.nagoji: Thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin and jaw with smooth skin, no beard or facial scar, and a tiny flush gold ear stud on the lobe with nothing hanging from it. As Ananthan Pillai: Kerala topknot high on the crown, black with only the first grey at the temples, no turban, plain cream or white mundu with no gold border, shoulder cloth, silver chain of office, the ivory-handled conch-marked knife at the waist, ridged nails and the pale ridged brand with the long white scar on the inner LEFT forearm above the wrist; no coat, forehead mark or sacred thread.
character_notes.padmini: In her fifties, thick black hair coiled at the nape with only light grey threading, far less grey than the sheet shows. Simple gold, a cream cotton sari with a narrow gold border hitched for walking in the old Kerala drape with no stitched blouse, and her long walking stick.
character_notes.varma: Face, moustache and build from his sheet, with black hair, never the grey of the sheet's later figure. In every panel of this chapter he wears the court look: cream-and-gold turban with the jewelled peacock-feather crest, pearl drop earrings, a red vertical forehead mark, pearl and gold necklaces, gold armlets, bare chest and a cream cloth with a broad gold border; never the bare-headed side knot.
character_notes.revathi: A little younger than Nagoji, black hair with no grey; indigo sari with gold, jasmine in her braid, flat-coin necklace, gold armlets and a sandalwood line at the hairline. Still a widow: no tali and no sindoor in the parting.
character_notes.keshavrao: About nineteen, clearly younger, smaller and thinner than Nagoji: a softer young face, a faint moustache and no beard, black hair hacked short, no ear stud. Torn grey-brown prisoner rags, never ochre, iron manacles on his thin wrists and a rain-washed graze at the hairline with no blood.
character_notes.nagoji_father: White-haired, bent with age, with old thick-knuckled hands; a coarse dhoti, a white pheta and a black wool kambal over one shoulder.
character_notes.nagoji_mother: White-haired and bent with age, in a nine-yard sari worn kashta-style, green glass bangles on her wrists and turmeric-stained hands.
character_notes.bhalerao: Shown only as hands: slim, ink-stained fingers at a cotton angarkha cuff, younger than Nagoji's. No face, and never drawn from the Nagoji sheet.
character_notes.sowcar: A Gujarati money changer in a small red pagdi and a white angarkha; an unnamed one-chapter face, never a principal's.
